name: NEXUS Error Handler
description: Catches failures from every other workflow and writes them to audit_log as FAILED, so the Automation screen shows them.

assignments.name: summary
assignments.value: ={{ [ (($json.execution && $json.execution.error && $json.execution.error.message) || ($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'Execution failed with no error message'), ($json.execution && $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted ? 'Failed at node: ' + $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted : null), ($json.execution && $json.execution.id ? 'Execution ' + $json.execution.id : null), ($json.execution && $json.execution.url ? $json.execution.url : null) ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ').slice(0, 1000) }}

assignments.name: unattributed
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const M = '[NEXUS-UNATTRIBUTED]'; const e = ($json.execution && $json.execution.error) || $json.error || {}; return String(e.description || '').indexOf(M) === 0 || String(e.message || '').indexOf(M) === 0; })() }}

nodes.name: Log Failure to audit_log

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const B = { 'default': 'fff6a2b5-cfd5-4460-8383-875bc5826de0' }; const U = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i; let m = {}; try { m = JSON.parse(String($env.NEXUS_TENANT_MAP || '')) || {}; } catch (e) { m = {}; } if (!m || typeof m !== 'object' || !Object.keys(m).length) m = B; const k = Object.keys(m); let t = null; if (k.length === 1 && U.test(String(m[k[0]] || ''))) t = String(m[k[0]]); const unattributed = $json.unattributed === true || $json.unattributed === 'true'; if (unattributed) t = null; const note = unattributed ? ' | TENANT UNRESOLVED (unauthenticated): the caller was never authenticated, so this failure belongs to no dealership' : ' | TENANT UNRESOLVED: an error trigger reports which workflow failed, not whose customer it was'; const base = { workflow: $json.workflow, status: $json.status, summary: (String($json.summary || '') + (t ? '' : note)).slice(0, 1000), logged_at: $json.logged_at }; return JSON.stringify(t ? Object.assign(base, { tenant_id: t }) : base); })() }}

nodes.notes: tenant_id is sent EXPLICITLY, including as null. It is not omitted: audit_log.tenant_id defaults to nexus_default_tenant_id(), so an absent key would stamp the unattributed-default dealership and put one dealership's failures on another's Automation screen. With one dealership configured the fallback names it, so today's behaviour is unchanged. Was an autoMapInputData Supabase node until 2 Sep 2026; swapped for HTTP so null and absent are distinguishable.

activeVersion.name: Read the unattributed marker from error.description too
activeVersion.description: Measured on execution 10487: n8n's Code node splits a thrown 'A: B' into error.description='A' and error.message='B [line N]', so a marker at the head of the throw lands in description and never reaches the summary. Build Failure Row now derives a boolean 'unattributed' from BOTH error.description and error.message at position 0, and the audit writer keys on that instead of parsing the summary. The summary itself is unchanged for genuine failures.
